annotations.title: Management's record against its own guidance

description: A management team's record against its own word: each quarter it gave guidance in its press release, what it said and what then happened, how often results came in above, within and below its own range, and which quarters fell short.

filed_before.description: Start from the latest release filed by this date.

measure.description: Only this measure, such as revenue or eps.

quarters.description: How many results releases to go back through; default 12.
